notes_for_editor: The sale sheet is undated and does not show the sale outcome. A GovDeals listing (asset 54154) appeared only in a search snippet; the page returned 403 to fetch_text and WebFetch, so it is not cited. The record's registers say GFC US 213 (tnlandforms gfc-213), but the sheet says GFC #10001 for the same coordinates; the conflict is not resolved here. BLL US 41110 is unsourced. The index name 'pretoria' is the tnlandforms author's label (the index says names for towers 73 and above are the author's creation). The sheet gives an overall height of about 100 feet, not a cab-floor height, so no height_m is set. No source on public access was found. The photo url is the Commons file page; its EXIF date is a camera date, not a verified photo date. Checked 2026-10-21: the fetched sale sheet text shows no date. The story attributes the 100-foot height to the sheet (undated, so it does not show present state), and the advice not to climb the tower was removed because the sheet does not say it.
